# Oversized button menus open outside their alignment constraint

## The problem

Open an ordinary `Neo.button.Base` with a `menu` full of commands, next to the right edge of a short viewport. At Engine `15d42c0c72`, a 27-row generic menu measured 382×758 at (982, −271) in a 1024×640 window. It had no internal scrolling and the last command was unreachable. The same defect appears in a consumer’s merge queue with 27 or 33 PRs.

## Owner and repair

The button already supplies a menu and target. `Neo.main.DomAccess#align` measures the subject and constraint and applies the dimensions and position from `Neo.util.Rectangle#alignTo`. If all allowed sides refuse the natural size, the search falls through with the last rejected rectangle. An oversized menu must use the available space at the trigger and scroll its own contents. Resolve the failed placement in the Engine. The existing successful-fit and flip cases, explicit size minima, target margin, final offset, and matched-axis behavior remain part of the contract. [Alignment ownership](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17824) · [Geometry](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/15d42c0c72/src/util/Rectangle.mjs#L474-L581) · [Main-thread placement](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/15d42c0c72/src/main/DomAccess.mjs#L247-L309)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An uncustomized button/menu near the right edge opens inside its constraint, without a consumer height, width or alignment override. A long menu at the top and at the bottom chooses a usable side. Reopen at a smaller size and activate the last command by scrolling the actual menu.
- [ ] Preserve small-menu natural size, first-fitting side order, valid explicit minima, matched dimensions, margins, overlap and post-placement offset semantics. Cover positive and impossible-fit boundaries with deterministic rectangle tests.
- [ ] Verify the original Fleet queue with the Engine change and its original stylesheet. Installed acceptance belongs with the original [consumer report](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/869).

Maintainer-owned because this changes shared floating geometry. Searched the latest 20 open Engine tickets, open/closed `alignTo` / `constrainTo` / floating-menu issues, own assignments, recent claims and prior-art recall. #17824 covers point targets and offsets. The menu animation and grid z-order tickets have distinct outcomes. Open backlog 60.
